info.title: ShareEd Backend API
info.description: Complete API documentation for ShareEd Backend. Built using Express and Prisma.

get.description: Verify the Supabase JWT token and sync the user profile into the local PostgreSQL database (auto-creates if it doesn't exist).
Retrieve posts with optional filtering and sorting.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Keyword search in post title or content

post.description: Create a new post. Limited to 3 posts per 24 hours per user.

get.description: Retrieve posts trending in the last 7 days.
Retrieve posts created by the currently authenticated user.
Retrieve a specific post details by its ID.

put.description: Update the title or status of an existing post.

404.description: Post not found or not author.

delete.description: Soft deletes a post by setting its status to ARCHIVED.

404.description: Post not found or not author.

get.description: Retrieve all comments written under a specific post.

post.description: Add a comment to a post. Sends a notification to the post owner.

404.description: Comment not found or not owner.
Comment not found or not owner.

get.description: Checks if the current user has liked the post.

post.description: Like the post if not liked yet, or unlike if already liked.

get.description: Retrieve all posts bookmarked by the user.

post.description: Bookmark a post, or remove it from bookmarks if already bookmarked.

400.description: Cannot follow yourself or already followed.

get.description: Retrieve followers list of a user.
Retrieve users that a specific user follows.
Retrieve notifications list of the authenticated user.

patch.description: Mark all user notifications as read.
Mark a single notification as read.

404.description: Notification not found or not owner.
Notification not found or not owner.

post.description: Report a post. Limit: 1 report per user per post. If a post gets 10 reports, it will be automatically deactivated (UNACTIVED).

get.description: Get list of reports submitted by the logged-in user.
Retrieve all posts that have been reported. Access restricted to MODERATOR and ADMIN roles.

200.description: List of reports and reported posts.

403.description: Forbidden - Role must be MODERATOR or ADMIN.

post.description: Perform moderation actions: RESTORE (re-activates post) or SOFT_DELETE (archives post).

get.description: Retrieve all milestones/achievements. Role required: ADMIN.

post.description: Create a new milestone/achievement. Role required: ADMIN.

put.description: Update an existing milestone/achievement. Role required: ADMIN.

delete.description: Delete a milestone/achievement. Role required: ADMIN.

400.description: Bad request (e.g., users have progress on it).

patch.description: Map an existing reward to a milestone. Role required: ADMIN.

reward_id.description: Reward ID to map, or null to unmap

get.description: Retrieve all registered users. Role required: ADMIN.

patch.description: Change user role to MEMBER, MODERATOR, or ADMIN. Role required: ADMIN.
Ban a user account by setting status to BANNED. Cannot ban an ADMIN account. Role required: ADMIN.

400.description: User is already banned or cannot ban admin.

patch.description: Restore a banned user account to ACTIVE status. Role required: ADMIN.

get.description: Retrieve public profile information of a user.

put.description: Update the authenticated user's profile detail including media files.

400.description: Username already taken or invalid data.

put.description: Update profile details with separate social fields and media uploads.
Initial profile setup for newly registered users.
Equip a purchased theme or frame item. Set itemId to null to unequip.

400.description: Invalid request or item not owned.

200.description: List of milestones with user progress.

post.description: Claim the reward item for a completed milestone.

400.description: Milestone not completed or already claimed.

post.description: Log out user, invalidate token, and terminate active session.
